why_it_matters: Assigning a public IP to an RDS instance allows anyone on the Internet to probe database listener ports directly.
Network-level exposure leaves database engines vulnerable to automated credential brute-forcing and unpatched protocol exploits.
Setting publicly_accessible to false prevents AWS from associating a public IP, restricting access to private subnets.
post_en:
Internet-facing database instances allow external attackers to probe database ports and launch automated brute-force attacks against database credentials.
Set publicly_accessible to false inside the aws_db_instance resource block.
This configuration prevents AWS from assigning a public IP address and isolates database endpoints strictly within private VPC subnets.
CKV_AWS_17 fails the first version and passes the second.
